headline: Srinivasan Ravi files SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure under Regulation 31(4) for Craftsman Automation Limited
sum: Substantial shareholder disclosure filed under SEBI Takeover Code. Srinivasan Ravi has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE relating to Craftsman Automation Limited, signalling a material acquisition or change in control position.
detail: The disclosure was filed with NSE under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), requiring public announcement of a material change in shareholding. The filing indicates either a proposed acquisition or a trigger event requiring disclosure; the precise transaction value, share quantity, and acquisition percentage remain disclosed in the full filing PDF but are not accessible in the Bar & Bench abstract. No corroborating press release, company announcement, or business press coverage was located during research.
